interpretation.qualification: physical nondependency established by owner at quiet pair setup; not bank difference; no source_done hard prerequisite for safety
interpretation.o_local: second child released at DMA true RLAST still needs TC/TL; banked N-disabled normal gate cannot process new request during V PT; N hit conditional, not free
interpretation.o_prepared: allow translation ahead and holding in existing TC state; do not count header SRAM or a full splitter as unavoidable
interpretation.stock_splitter: existing module splits to single beats, not directly a 2x128 completion pacer; reuse/ordinary adaptation remains allowed
interpretation.first_pte_target: M-ID requires effective S1 root page wholly in DRAM decode, root/context/route frozen. Otherwise successful non-DRAM P1 then DRAM P2 is an association counterexample; active alone cannot solve it. Root range source extracts/hashes in M evidence.
